court: In the High Court of Madras
respondents: State of Tamil Nadu Represented by its Principal Secretary, Public Works Department
advocates: For Petitioner: Ms. B. Sneha, for Mr. L. Chandrakumar
For Respondent: Mr. L.S.M. Hasan Fizal, Additional Government Pleader
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking a writ of certiorarified Mandamus, calling for records relating to the order of the respondents made in G.O.(2D) 35 Public Works (E1) Department, dated 17-6-2020 to quash the same and to consequently direct the respondent to appropriately revise and re-fix the pension and other pensionary benefits w.e.f., 1-6-2017 inclusive of the arrears thereto.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

T. Vinod Kumar, J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo, dated 9-3-2026 seeking permission of this Court to withdraw the Writ Petition with a liberty to re-agitate the issue after the outcome of Crl.A. Nos. 001027 and 001028 of 2023 stated to be pending before the Supreme Court of India.

2. In view of the memo filed by the learned counsel for the petitioner, this Writ Petition is dismissed as withdrawn subject to the liberty as noted above. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
